import_provenance.original_title: Fully dynamic linear programming with outliers
import_provenance.original_statement: Can a set of planar halfplane constraints support arbitrary insertions and deletions while maintaining a point minimizing a fixed linear objective and violating at most k constraints, in k^O(1)polylog(n) amortized update time and near-linear-plus-poly(k) space? The deletion time of a constraint must not have to be announced when it is inserted.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The cited semi-online structure assumes advance knowledge of deletion times; the fully dynamic extension is an explicit open direction, with the displayed bound an editorial benchmark.
